title: Inventory Observation (v1)
description: Schema for individual records under state/inventory/observations/<observation_id>.json. An observation is one scanned item (file, directory, or external source record) and its provisional match/outcome, before it is promoted, quarantined, or archived. Paths are always sanitized and root-relative via a symbolic token — never absolute device paths, drive letters, home directories, or account-specific segments.

report_ref.description: id of the state/inventory/reports/<report_id>.json this observation belongs to.

path.description: Sanitized, symbolic-root-relative location of the observed item, e.g. "${INBOX}/retro/snes/unmatched-01".

sha256.description: Present when kind == "file" and the file was hashed.

outcome.description: Result of applying retention policy precedence, plus "unmatched" for items with no confident match yet.
